title: governance_cost.py reads 10.7% of the CI seconds a merge pays: final head only, latest attempt only
claim: governance_cost.py sums check-run durations at a pull request's FINAL head from the default check-runs listing, which returns the latest attempt only. Over the window's 271 merges that surface reads 3,100,885 s of the 28,895,795 s their CI ran at every commit of the pull request (filter=all) plus the merge commit: omitted_share 0.893 (by day 0.857..0.921 over 8 day-cells; 0.896 with the lowest day dropped; 0.887 with runs deduplicated across stacked PRs). Mean seconds per merge read 11,442 against 106,627 paid, a 9.3x under-read. At the final heads alone the default listing hides 37,189 run attempts (5,331,965 s) that filter=all returns, although d11lib.check_runs's docstring says the listing shows a re-run. The governance share barely moves (0.204 vs 0.186), so the split survives; the per-merge cost the instrument reports does not.

evidence.unit: omitted_share = 1 - head-surface seconds / all seconds paid
evidence.machine: box B8 (light seat), Linux 6.18.44 container; network-bound, GitHub-reported durations and counts
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; the number is a count / GitHub-reported duration, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/audit/round4/D11/governance_cost.py:GOV, :bare and :dur (every second is classified and timed by the instrument's own symbols); tools/audit/round4/D11/d11lib.py:check_runs's listing reproduced (default filter)
perturbation: D13S3_HEAD_ONLY=1 (the full surface collapses onto governance_cost.py's): omitted_share moves 0.893 -> 0.0; --gov-drop pr-contract moves governance share 0.204 -> 0.197 (the instrument's own control)
metric_definition: omitted_share = 1 - sum over merges of concluded check-run seconds at the final PR head (default listing) / sum of concluded check-run seconds at every PR commit (filter=all) plus the merge commit
phenomenon_property: A per-merge CI-cost reading sums every concluded check-run attempt the merge triggered: every head the pull request had, every re-run attempt, and the push run at its merge commit
proposed_fix_scope: read check runs with filter=all at each commit of pulls/<n>/commits and at the merge commit, report the head-only figure beside it; correct check_runs's docstring; S. Null control: single-commit, no-rerun merges still omit 0.492 (the merge-commit push run alone)
